easyPrerequisites:
You have a card in hand.
You can cause an artifact to enter under your control.
description:
Cause an artifact to enter under your control.
When the artifact enters, Quicksmith Genius triggers, causing you to rummage.
Magmakin Artillerist triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating a Treasure token for each opponent that was dealt damage.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Quicksmith Genius triggers that many times.
Resolve a Quicksmith Genius trigger, causing you to rummage.
Repeat from step 3.
